notes.title: Celebrating 8 Years Since the International Steam release of Symphonic Rain!
notes.notes: [p]Originally released in 2004, KOGADO Studio's masterpiece Symphonic Rain was released internationally for the first time 8 years ago today![/p][p]Adored by fans for its deeply emotional and well-crafted narrative, memorable music, and strong character development ( 96% Overwhelmingly Positive on Steam!), Symphonic Rain combines the exquisite story writing of Maoto Nishikawa, masterful artwork of Siro, and beautiful melodies of Ritsuko Okazaki into an unforgettable masterpiece.[/p][p]Set in Piova, a city of music and endless rain, Symphonic Rain explores the story of Chris Vertin, a student at the Piova Communal School of Music as he attempts to master the magical instrument known as the Fortelle, while grappling with his own melancholy.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28754622/4da1c1ce21d108412e9bd9a5f510082ef0cccf67.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Hatsune Miku VR update, new DLC, sale and huge giveaway!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32526477/b7058c944b684b73813de1139bf92ee9ae9a650e.png[/img]

First up, Hatsune Miku VR just got an update and new DLC bringing the total songs up to 19!

[h1]Update[/h1]
[list][*][b]Stage Select Screen[/b]
Added a costume and stick select (new Snow Miku & Negi available)
[*][b]Music Video mode[/b]
New song select screen: choose 8 songs to watch as a playlist with new costume select, stick select and stage select too.
[*][b]Sound enhancements[/b]
Rebalanced volume levels and changed in-game music to 3D sound.
[*][b]New free song[/b]
STELLA (by KotsubaneP)
[*][b]New free stage[/b]
Snow stage
[/list]

[h1]Sale[/h1]
And if that wasn't enough, we also have a sale on!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/707300/

[h1]Contest[/h1]
And to celebrate the update, DLC and launching on the Oculus store, we have a contest running on Gleam with prizes which include official Miku goodies, tickets to the Hatsune Miku Expo in Hong Kong in July and more!
Check the link below to enter:
https://gleam.io/bJt0s/hatsune-miku-vr-oculus-rift-experiences-launch

notes.title: Symphonic Rain: Update to Chinese Simplified translation
notes.notes:
The Chinese Simplified translation has now been updated.
Thanks for you reports.

notes.title: Symphonic Rain: Update - Steam overlay support
notes.notes:
We're happy to let you know that Symphonic Rain was now updated to support Steam Overlay correctly.

Enjoy taking screenshots of Chris and his friends with one stroke of F12 !
